consequence: For one normally completed output, distinct certificates under the same unchanged rule can report failure and then success. The retained reducer specifies assignment without a contradiction guard, permitting the later success to determine qualification, whereas SettlePerformanceEvidence requires unresolved conflict. It also rejects a valid certificate received after complete content but before protocol FINAL. The supplied new metrics check handles these cases within its own reducer; that does not establish compatibility with the retained Goodput algorithm.
bounded_repair: Define and enforce the interface between the reducers. Either update CohortGoodput to retain early certificates and reject identity or fixed-rule verdict conflicts, or explicitly require normalized certificates from SettlePerformanceEvidence and describe the adapter that buffers early evidence and propagates conflicts. Preserve H/J and output/rule identities. Add a cross-reducer fixture for early certification and for failure-then-success certificates without a rule revision.
